02 / ORGANIZATION NEWS

A new chapter begins

Equipment and apparel partnership · Effective January 1, 2027

NINTH INNING × UNDER ARMOUR + RAWLINGS

Ninth Inning Family,

Beginning January 1, 2027, we're excited to start a new partnership with Under Armour and Rawlings, brands that share our commitment to performance, development, and helping athletes reach their full potential.

Through this partnership, Ninth Inning athletes and families will have access to premium products, exclusive team merchandise, and special shopping opportunities including discounted apparel and equipment!

We're incredibly excited for what's ahead and look forward to sharing more details very soon.

03 / MEET THE STAFF

Luke Crisp

Coach · Catching & arm care instruction

Meet Coach Luke

This week, we're highlighting Luke Crisp. Luke currently coaches one of our 11U Blue Jays teams and the 15U Royals in Chamblee. He is also one of the three instructors for our Sub 2 Catchers Program and Arm Care Program.

Luke grew up in Atlanta and attended Maynard Jackson High School. His college years as a catcher were with Southeast Missouri State University and Coastal Carolina University.

He recently graduated from Kennesaw State University with a Bachelor of Science in Sports Management.

Off the field, he enjoys being outdoors, duck hunting, and fishing.
